purpose: Numeric finish line for Magmaw 10N bots: per-actor kill DPS on par with the matched Warcraft Logs reference, measured over a batch of native kills rather than one noisy run.

unmatched_reference_notes.xAhkN2y9YP3KRmnJ-fight10: Short 70.9 s fight with eight DPS and no Balance Druid; throughput context only, never a target.

actor_dps_metric: Per actor: mean encounter_window_dps over the label's native-clear kills divided by the median actor_dps of the matched references for the same spec. target_dps is that WCL median; the actor passes when ratio >= actor_dps_ratio.
party_dps_metric: Mean encounter_window_party_dps over native-clear kills divided by the median raid_dps of the matched references. Reported, not gating.

clear_rule.basis: report.json native_gameplay_outcome.native_clear and completion_reason. The harness exit code is informational: diagnostic route runs exit 1 (all_passed=false) even on a clean native clear.

boss_window_deaths_basis: Lethal landed damage on a party member inside the encounter route node or encounter window, reconciled with the route death count. Unknown counts never pass.
healer_status: Healers have no DPS target; their status follows the encounter status.
missing_reference_policy: An actor whose spec has no matched reference gets status no_reference and no target. The overall status is fail until a matched reference exists: a missing reference is work, not a pass.

status_rules.encounter: fail if any kill of the label is not a native clear, or any kill has more than max_boss_window_deaths boss-window deaths or an unknown count; otherwise insufficient_kills below kills_per_measurement native clears; otherwise pass.
status_rules.actor: no_reference without a matched spec reference; insufficient_kills below kills_per_measurement; otherwise pass or fail against actor_dps_ratio.
status_rules.overall: pass only if the encounter passes and every non-healer actor passes.

noise_rule.statistic: sample mean and sample standard deviation (n - 1) over native-clear kills
noise_rule.insufficient_kills: either label has fewer than min_kills_per_label native-clear kills
noise_rule.applies_to: each actor's encounter_window_dps and the party encounter_window_party_dps
noise_rule.keep_rule: Keep a change only if party DPS or the targeted actor improved, no non-healer actor regressed, route deaths per kill did not increase, and every kill of the candidate label is a native clear. Otherwise revert.

run_plan.duration_policy: completion-watchdog: stop on native clear, no-progress stall, repeated decisions, death loops or infrastructure loss. There is no success timer.
